backend/main.mo: Main backend actor with hardcoded product data and query functions to filter products by category, price range, and rating; includes MixinStorage for blob storage capabilities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: product catalog display, filtering sidebar, and modern e-commerce design theme with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend source files describing components for product display, filtering, and catalog layout with e-commerce styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom CSS variables defining a complete design system for light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with title 'Shop Filter' and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders the CatalogPage as the main application view.
frontend/src/components/FilterSidebar.ts: Sidebar component with category checkboxes, price range slider, and rating filters with clear functionality and active filter indicators.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying image, name, description, category badge, rating, and price with hover animations and category-based image mapping.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Responsive grid layout component that renders product cards with loading skeleton states and empty state messaging.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors with query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useProductFilters.ts: Custom hook that manages product filtering state (categories, price range, rating) and applies client-side filtering logic to products fetched from backend queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching products from the backend actor with queries for all products, by category, by price range, and by rating.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm e-commerce color palette using OKLCH color space for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CatalogPage.tsx: Main catalog page component displaying a header, hero banner, filter sidebar, and product grid with footer, using the useProductFilters hook to manage filtering state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (product catalog, filtering sidebar, visual design) and pending backend requirements (data model, query methods, sample data seeding).
